assets.name: stage_soaking
assets.prompt:
Create a STRICTLY FLAT 2D vector-style illustration for a Material Design botanical mobile app, SproutPace. This must look like clean geometric SVG artwork, NOT a 3D render, NOT realistic, NOT a painting. Solid uniform color fills ONLY. ZERO gradients, ZERO shading, ZERO highlights, ZERO texture, ZERO glow, ZERO shadows, ZERO bevels. Simplified large rounded geometric silhouettes, organic oval leaves, extremely few shapes, no outlines. Straight-on front view with only a narrow flat ellipse or trapezoid to indicate container opening, NO isometric perspective. Restrained palette: forest green #105C3B, lime #A5D66D, sage #D3E8C1, soil #765B2D, ochre #DDC38E; water may use muted blue #A9D8DD. Visual clarity at 96x72dp, balanced 4:3 landscape composition, generous 15% transparent padding. Genuine transparent background including all empty gaps. No text, labels, logo, border, background blob or decorative sparkles. One isolated illustration, not a sheet of variants.
Subject: A simple broad transparent bowl represented by a pale blue flat semicircular bowl silhouette with a level water line, containing exactly five simple ochre oval seeds. Seeds fully below water line, no leaves, no sprouts. Only about 10 shapes total.
